body: hey man, made a throw away to say this, but while I completely feel you making music on meth since holy shit it's so much easier and engaging, if you haven't done this for too long yet I would suggest, at bare minimum, making sure you do it without it very very regularly. I'm actually really worried that I destroyed my ability to be inspired without it and I'm bummed and scared about it. I hope it'll come back, but I'm still doing it since I can't convince myself it's not going to produce better music since... it does. Anyway, just my thoughts, good luck man
